description:
Crypto trade setups for Binance spot pairs, long or short: up to 10 with entry, stop, tp1, tp2, rr, confidence, gate (1h and 4h trend agree) and expires_at; empty when nothing qualifies. 0.05 USDC base (new payers 0.075, >10 payments 0.035; 1 pack call); fresh=true 5x. Pay via x402 (params._meta["x402/payment"]), a bundle_token or a payment_tx.
After: validate_setup for the top setup (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Token from buy_signal_pack, buy_subscription (pro/desk) or buy_enterprise instead of paying per call.

fresh.description: Bypass the 120 s cache: 5x price, 5 bundle calls.

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from: the payment-required error quotes your tier (0 payments +50 %, 1-10 base, >10 -30 %) and, from the third payment, an upgrade with your own spend.

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

symbols.description: Binance spot pairs, e.g. BTCUSDT. Optional: default 16 liquid USDT pairs.

name: get_signals
title: TradeSignal: crypto trade setups
